welcome.title: Tauri + Svelte 5 Template
welcome.subtitle: Every tile below both documents a built-in feature and triggers it. Delete src/lib/components/demo/ when you start your own app.
welcome.toast.message: That's a toast, powered by svelte-sonner.
welcome.confirm.title: Delete this item?
welcome.confirm.description: This is a demo — nothing will actually be deleted.
welcome.tiles.palette.title: Command Palette
welcome.tiles.palette.description: Fuzzy-search every registered command. Keyboard, palette, and native menu all dispatch through the same registry.
welcome.tiles.preferences.title: Preferences
welcome.tiles.preferences.description: A dialog with sidebar navigation, backed by a JSON file in the app data directory.
welcome.tiles.theme.title: Theme
welcome.tiles.theme.description: Light, dark, or follow the system — plus full color themes: install any of 65 bundled VS Code themes, import your own, or tune the anchors in Preferences → Appearance. Persisted and repainted before the window is shown, so there's no flash on startup.
welcome.tiles.sidebars.title: Left Sidebar
welcome.tiles.sidebars.description: Drag the divider to resize. Hidden panels keep their width, so showing one again restores it exactly.
welcome.tiles.rightSidebar.title: Right Sidebar
welcome.tiles.rightSidebar.description: Same resizable panel setup on the other edge. Visibility is saved with the rest of the app state.
welcome.tiles.quickPane.title: Quick Pane
welcome.tiles.quickPane.description: A separate always-on-top window with its own Vite entry point. Its global shortcut works even while another app is focused.
welcome.tiles.toast.title: Toasts
welcome.tiles.toast.description: Transient messages that follow the current theme.
welcome.tiles.toastAction.title: Toast with an Action
welcome.tiles.toastAction.description: A toast can carry a button — handy for undo.
welcome.tiles.confirm.title: Confirm Dialog
welcome.tiles.confirm.description: A promise-based confirmation you can await from anywhere, no local dialog state required.
welcome.tiles.notification.title: Notifications
welcome.tiles.notification.description: Native OS notifications, including the one-time permission request.
welcome.tiles.clipboardCopy.title: Clipboard: Write
welcome.tiles.clipboardCopy.description: Write text to the system clipboard.
welcome.tiles.clipboardRead.title: Clipboard: Read
welcome.tiles.clipboardRead.description: Read the clipboard back and show it in a toast.
welcome.tiles.fileDialog.title: File Dialog
welcome.tiles.fileDialog.description: The native file picker from tauri-plugin-dialog.
welcome.tiles.shell.title: Shell Command
welcome.tiles.shell.description: Runs a subprocess whose executable and arguments are pinned by the capability file — nothing user-supplied reaches the shell.
welcome.tiles.greet.title: Rust Command
welcome.tiles.greet.description: Calls a Rust function over IPC with types generated by tauri-specta.
welcome.tiles.relaunch.title: Restart
welcome.tiles.relaunch.description: Relaunches the app via tauri-plugin-process, after a confirmation.
welcome.tiles.crash.title: Error Boundary
welcome.tiles.crash.description: Throws during render to show the fallback UI. The title bar and command palette stay usable.
